questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman came to the emergency department with a H/O of a fall on the bathroom floor. O/E, a 3*1 incised wound is present in the forearm. The CMO wants to administer LA for suturing the wound. The patient gives past H/O allergic reactions to some drugs. Which among the following LAs can be administered to this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Prilocaine

Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 387, Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No.No. 406

questions.stem: A 40-year-old patient was given Lignocaine for a dental procedure. In which order, the blockade of sensation will occur:
questions.solutionHtml:
Pain > Temperature > Touch > Deep pressure
  • Local anaesthetics cause pain to disappear first, followed by loss of the sensations of temperature (cold > hot), touch, deep pressure, and motor function.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No.No. 409 Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No.No. 389

questions.stem: A surgeon has applied a field block with lignocaine for performing appendicectomy. The blockade of fibres will occur in the following order:

options.label: A
options.text: C B A δ Aγ, Aβ, Aα fibres

options.label: B
options.text: B C A δ Aγ, Aβ, Aα fibres

options.label: C
options.text: A δ B C Aγ, Aβ, Aα fibres

options.label: D
options.text: Aγ, Aβ, Aα A δ B C fibres

questions.answerText: B C A δ Aγ, Aβ, Aα fibres
questions.solutionHtml:
B > C > A δ > Aγ, Aβ, Aα fibres
  • The order of blockade of fibres by LAs is B > small unmyelinated C (pain) > small myelinated Aδ (temperature) > larger myelinated Aγ, Aβ, Aα (touch, pressure & motor information).


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 409

questions.stem: A 36-year-old male with hydrocoele is posted for surgery. The doctor decides to give infiltration anaesthesia. He adds Adrenaline to the local anaesthetic solution. This combination provides the following except:

options.label: A
options.text: Prolongs the duration of local anaesthesia

options.label: C
options.text: Provides a more bloodless field for surgery

options.label: D
options.text: Enhances the intensity of nerve block

questions.solutionHtml:
Increases the anaesthetised area

Addition of a vasoconstrictor - adrenaline (1:50,000 to 1:200,000)



Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 409, 410 Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 389, 390

questions.stem: A 29-year-old female in labour was administered a LA for prolonged analgesia. Suddenly she developed ventricular arrhythmia. Which of the following LA would have been administered to her?
questions.solutionHtml:
Bupivacaine
  • Option: C. Bupivacaine is more cardiotoxic & produces ventricular tachycardia, fibrillation, and arrest.


Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 390, 393

questions.stem: A post-operative patient is on bupivacaine for prolonged analgesia. He suddenly developed ventricular tachyarrhythmia. What is the drug of choice for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Intralipid
  • Option: A. Recently, IV infusion of lipid emulsion has been used for bupivacaine cardiotoxicity, probably by extracting lipophilic bupivacaine from plasma and cardiac tissues.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 412 Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 393, 573

questions.stem: A local anaesthetic was administered to a patient aged 36 years. He is a normotensive patient, but his blood pressure increased after LA. Which of the following drug was administered?
questions.solutionHtml:
Cocaine

Cocaine is a powerfully addictive stimulant drug made from the leaves of the coca plant native to South America. Although healthcare providers can use it for valid medical purposes, such as local anesthesia for some surgeries, recreational cocaine use is illegal. As a street drug, cocaine looks like a fine, white crystal powder. Street dealers often mix it with things like cornstarch, talcum powder, or flour to increase profits



Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 390, 392, 393

questions.stem: A 23-year-old burns patient was posted for a split skin graft harvesting. The plastic surgeon wants to administer EMLA (Eutectic mixture of local anaesthetics) to achieve surface anaesthesia. What is the composition of EMLA?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lidocaine (2.5%) + Prilocaine (2.5%)

Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 413., Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 392

questions.stem: Which of the following drug is used for hypotension during spinal anaesthesia?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ephedrine

questions.stem: Which FDA Approved drug is used to reverse or shorten the duration of soft-tissue anaesthesia when Sympathomimetics are used with local anaesthetics?

Phentolamine

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 155

questions.stem: An anticholinergic drug was used for an overactive urinary bladder and was found to have local anaesthetic properties. The drug is:

Oxybutynin
